ledger.note: 8 September 1278: the first paréage makes Andorra a co-principality. Infobox 'First Paréage: 8 September 1278'; 'The conflict was resolved in 1278 with the mediation of the king of Aragon, Peter III' by a paréage 'which provided that Andorra's sovereignty be shared between the count of Foix' and the Bishop of Urgell (Andorra page, re-read 2026-10-31). Second page: the History of Andorra page has the sentence 'Andorra's borders have remained unchanged since 1278'; it is not on the Andorra page. A second paréage followed in 1288. The valleys come from the Bishop of Urgell's lordship, not from the Crown of Aragon; county-of-foix books a 1278 'gain' of the same land from the bishop, which is a co-princely relation (shared sovereignty), not a territorial gain.

region.text: the valleys of Andorra: Cliopatria's one-cell shape of 1279-1808

ledger.note: 1278: Andorra is a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia, so under the Crown of Aragon. 'Andorra was formed as a polity by a charter in 1278, being a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia until 1715.' (Andorra page, re-read 2026-10-31). The Principality of Catalonia is read as the Crown of Aragon's. Doubts: the Co-princes of Andorra page has 'initially as a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia' tagged [citation needed] and 'the sovereign of those lands, the monarch of Aragon in 1278'; both pages and the History of Andorra page have the bishop persuade the Bourbon authorities in 1716 that the valleys 'had always been neutral and unrelated to the Principality of Catalonia'; the paréage shares the sovereignty between the count of Foix and the bishop. Drawn as a vassal tint at confidence 2. Mirror: crown-of-aragon records a vassal_start with counterpart co-principality-of-andorra.

notes:
Written by the Phase B agent eu-12-b on 2026-10-25 from two pages (the two Andorra pages read for county-of-urgell; the page budget of that state covered them). WebFetch returns paraphrase for part of each page.
NEW STATE FROM A SPLIT ROW. Cliopatria's 'County of Urgell' row holds 14 shapes for 1279-1808 that are one H3 cell (the valleys of Andorra), not the county; this dossier reviews them (cliopatria_names 'County of Urgell'), the county-of-urgell dossier reviews 870-1235. The co-principality is the same state as the 'Principality of Andorra' row (1815-2024, group eu-20, Wikidata Q228): the annexation of 1812-1813 and the restoration of 1814 separate them. The orchestrator should have one dossier for 1278 to today: either merge this one into principality-of-andorra (cliopatria_names both Names; this dossier's start 1278, no 1812 dissolve) or keep both with the colour of the later one taken from this one.
YEARS NOT DRAWN. The History of Andorra page: 'Andorra was briefly annexed to the Crown of Aragon twice, in 1396 and 1512' (no end year, no extent; not drawn, and Cliopatria draws no break); the second paréage of 1288; the edict of 1607 ('established the head of the French state and the bishop of Urgell as co-lords of Andorra'); 'saw most of their rights abolished in 1716'; 'Napoleon I reestablished the Co-Principate in 1809'. None of these changes a border. Tried again 2026-10-31 for the ends of the Aragonese annexations of 1396 and 1512: the History of Andorra, Co-princes of Andorra and Andorra pages give no end year and no extent (the Co-princes page does not mention them at all), so no occupation_start/occupation_end is written; the pages to try are the pages for the Crown of Aragon in 1396 (Martin I) and Ferdinand II in 1512, which are not in this budget.
CLIOPATRIA GAPS. 1809-1814: the row has no shape, but the state lived to the annexation of 1812 (new keyframe 1809-1812); 1813-1814 the valleys are French (Sègre). Cliopatria's Crown of Aragon shape of 1236-1278 holds the cell too (all 18 cells of the former county of Urgell) and drops it in 1279; the Bishop of Urgell's lordship held the valleys then, so the Crown dossier should subtract the cell for 1236-1278 (it is the Crown's only as a vassal from 1278, below).
AREA. 468 km2 on the Andorra page against 309-404 km2 in the shapes (ratio 0.66-0.86), within a factor of two.
Gazetteer names needed: none (Cliopatria shape used).

Applied: (1) a vassal chain: 1278 (September) vassal_start to crown-of-aragon, 1516 vassal_end and vassal_start to kingdom-of-spain (confidence 1: the pages are silent on 1516, bridged from kingdom-of-spain's merge of the Crown), 1715 vassal_end; the Andorra page says 'a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia until 1715', which I read as the Crown's; the Co-princes page tags that claim [citation needed] and the 1716 plea of the bishop says the valleys were 'neutral and unrelated to the Principality of Catalonia', so the tint is confidence 2 and may be wrong. (2) One holder for 1133-1278: the Bishop of Urgell's lordship (predecessor slug bishopric-of-urgell, found counterpart 'Bishop of Urgell' as county-of-foix writes it); the Crown is no longer named as predecessor. (3) The 'borders unchanged' quote is attributed to the History of Andorra page only. Disagreements with the reviewer: none. Left open (pages silent): the ends of the 1396 and 1512 annexations, the 1793-1809 French renunciation. For eu-10: county-of-foix /ledger/1 (1278 gain of Andorra from 'Bishop of Urgell', confidence 3) should be a co-princely relation, not a territorial gain, or the Andorra cell is owned twice from 1278.
